title: fieldwork::video — FFmpeg integration for transcoding and thumbnails
description: Video processing module in fieldwork. Wraps FFmpeg as subprocess. HLS transcoding (multiple resolutions), thumbnail extraction, duration/resolution detection, animated preview GIF generation. Pure logic — no DB. All three servers use this.
close_reason: PeerTube video mode complete. videos_db (28 tests, 7 tables), FFmpeg command builder (8 tests), PeerTube API v1 (13 endpoints) in all 3 servers. Write endpoints stubbed 501 pending transcoding worker.
